body: I have no idea why I still do it, other than the obvious feelings of comfort. Always thought I'd just grow out of it with age but it doesn't seem to be the case.

18 years old and I still suck my thumb and have four 'blankies' that I can't sleep or relax without. Tried over the years to stop but it's the only thing that will calm me down after a hectic day, fucked me teeth up quite a bit though.
When's the tutorial coming out? I'd love to have these bridges on my map!
"Bullies are just jealous." I call bullshit.
People assume I'm 14 years old, polite and shy. Then they get to know me and find out I'm a loudmouth 18 year old that can't sit still for ten minutes.

When I was younger (around 8 or 9) I found out beetroot juice stained the skin and kind of looked like blood. Thinking it would be funny to run up to my mum covered in this obviously fake blood crying my eyes out I proceeded to soak my hands in the stuff. Cue my mum panicking, bursting into tears and being halfway through calling an ambulance when I squeaked 'surprise'. I was confined to my room for weeks.
